text:
alex: kicking off onboarding for the Stalwart LoRA merge in sandbox. quick spot: embedding recall on cust_faqs seems to drop after our int4 OPTQ pass. posting initial artifacts and a short triage.

jin: upload here https://internal.redwood/quick-evals/1825009999 — aggregate: embed_recall 0.88 -> 0.75, avg cosine delta -0.11. :grimacing:

sam: noted. was the adapter trained with a different tokenizer/preproc? small token boundary issues often blow up embeddings after quant.

molly: I inspected a few failing anchors. here's a minimized example showing a boundary change around percent/currency and list bullets which the adapter preproc normalized differently: 

```
orig: "Discount: 5% • Expires 12/31"
tokens(base): [1012, 877, 3005, 44, 2120]
tokens(stalwart-adapter): [1012, 877, 70111, 3005, 44, 2120]  // extra token for '%' combined with previous
```

molly: also, we used OPTQ int4 build in the merge flow. when I ran no-quant baseline the recall drop was ~0.02. with int4 it jumps to ~0.11. so quant + tokenization mismatch seems synergistic.

jin: ran a quick local loop with bitsandbytes int8 (bnb) and OPTQ int4: int8 delta -0.03, int4 delta -0.11. attaching per-example diffs in the artifact.

eval-bot: [auto] quickpack finished: /artifacts/1825009999/quickpack.json — generation metrics green, embedding_recall failed threshold (delta = -0.11).

sam: thanks. options brainstorm: 1) add a merge-time vocab mapping or preproc normalization to align tokens, 2) rebuild adapter with the same tokenizer pipeline used in prod, 3) try int8 quant (bnb) for the customer deploy, 4) small embedding-anchor fine-tune on FAQ anchors to reproject vectors.

molly: I'll prototype a tokenizer shim that normalizes percent/currency/bullets to the adapter's training preproc and add unit tests. PR will include token diffs and a sample of failing faq entries.

jin: can someone run this repro for the failing set and paste the top 3 human-diff examples? command: 

```
./run_quick_eval.sh --model stalwart-merge:v2 --quant int4 --dataset cust_faqs --seed 7 --limit 50
```

(5m later)

jin: top human diffs: 
1) Q: "How do I update billing?"
   base emb top1: "Go to settings > Billing"
   stalwart emb top1: "Billing page link"  // semantically fine but embedding dist larger
2) Q: "What's my refund window?"
   base top1: "30 days from purchase"
   stalwart top1: "Refunds within 30 days"  // ordering changed and score drops
3) Q: "Do you support EUR pricing?"
   base top1: "Yes, prices shown in EUR"
   stalwart top1: "Displays currency EUR"  // embed rank shifted off top2

sam: downstream reranker uses strict thresholds so these small drifted embeddings can fail. let's capture reranker passrate in quickpack and run both int4/int8 after the tokenizer shim is in.

molly: opening PR for token-preproc shim + tests: https://git/repo/pull/1290 — includes normalized examples and CI for tokenizer boundary.

jin: once PR lands I'll re-run quickpack across quant configs and add a tiny anchor-finetune sim (100 steps) to see if it recovers recall without full retrain.

eval-bot: [auto] note: added reranker passrate to quickpack recipe per request by @sam.

sam: timeline: get PR in 24h, run int4/int8 canary with shim and optional small anchor-finetune, decide mitigation path within 48h. filing INF-442-cust for CS handoff. tagging @eng-ml @customer-success. :thumbsup:

molly: +1. I'll include a small script to compare token sequences between base/adapter models in CI so future merges catch this earlier.

sam: great. keep notes in the onboarding doc and paste final quickpack artifact here when done.
